claim_boundary: A passing lane record proves only a MAP lane's directed HH-SIB road-axis corridor and projected station envelope. It does not prove a SUMO lane index, lateral lane order, legal lane-to-lane connection, stop line, conflict area, signal group binding, or final network correctness. Passing stitch candidates authorize only an approach-level corridor cut at an exact HH-SIB lane-profile transition; every lane-index assignment remains an automatic abstention.
